title: Runtime policy_denied stream frame for a GATEWAY denial (lead note 3)
description: The rendered template's AfterToolCall hook turns a tool result carrying the I8 deny text into this frame, drained by the existing __LAUNCHPAD_POLICY_DRAIN__ splice, so the console PolicyDenyCard renders unchanged. source=gateway tells policy_enforcement.record_runtime_decision NOT to write a second row (the gateway line is the system of record). decision_id may be null when the MCP client drops error.data.
